Directing Actors: Single and Multi-Camera Conventions

In this module, students will develop practical and conceptual skills for directing actors working from their own scripts or pre-existing screenplays, in both single and multi-camera production environments.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Collaborate with actors to shape performance for screen, applying directing techniques suited to both single and multi-camera environments.

+  Plan and execute short, filmed scenes using industry-standard workflows, demonstrating appropriate use of camera coverage, blocking, and visual storytelling.

+  Apply knowledge of historical and contemporary directing practices to inform creative and technical decision-making and reflect critically on their own directing process, demonstrating independent learning, problem-solving, and the ability to incorporate feedback into future projects.
